blocks.zh: Section 0: Introduction & Glossary / 導論與術語詞彙表
blocks.en: Section 0: Introduction & Glossary

blocks.zh: 本節學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解資料完整性（Data Integrity）的核心定義，以及 ALCOA+ 原則（可歸屬性、可辨識性、同步性、原始性、準確性，加上完整性、一致性、持久性、可用性）在製藥製造中的實際意義。
blocks.en: Understand the core definition of data integrity and the practical meaning of the ALCOA+ principles (attributable, legible, contemporaneous, original, accurate, plus complete, consistent, enduring and available) in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

blocks.zh: 掌握 TR84 的適用範圍——僅涵蓋製造與包裝作業，並區分其與實驗室（TR80）及品質管理系統資料完整性文件的差異。
blocks.en: Know the scope of TR84, which covers manufacturing and packaging operations only, and how it differs from the laboratory document (TR80) and from data integrity documents for quality management systems.

blocks.zh: 能夠正確使用並解釋本章關鍵術語：Audit Trail（稽核軌跡）、Data Lifecycle（資料生命週期）、Hybrid System（混合系統）、True Copy（真實副本）、Data Vulnerability（資料脆弱性）等。
blocks.en: Be able to use and explain the key terms in this section correctly: Audit Trail, Data Lifecycle, Hybrid System, True Copy, Data Vulnerability, and others.

blocks.zh: 了解主要監管機構（FDA、MHRA、WHO）對資料完整性定義的異同，以及以風險為基礎（QRM）方法在建立資料完整性控制措施上的重要性。
blocks.en: Understand how the major regulators (FDA, MHRA, WHO) differ and agree in their definitions of data integrity, and why a risk-based (QRM) approach matters when establishing data integrity controls.

blocks.zh: 本節內容索引
blocks.en: Section Index

blocks.zh: Introduction and Scope / 導論與範疇
blocks.en: Introduction and Scope

blocks.zh: 中文解析與應用
blocks.en: Commentary and Application

blocks.zh: 核心概念：資料完整性 (Data Integrity)
blocks.en: Core Concept: Data Integrity

blocks.zh: TR84 開宗明義：資料完整性是「確立並維持對產品品質與病患安全信心」的基石。換言之，沒有可信賴的資料，GMP 合規就是空話。
blocks.en: TR84 opens by stating that data integrity is the foundation for establishing and maintaining confidence in product quality and patient safety. Put simply, without trustworthy data, GMP compliance is an empty claim.

blocks.zh: 資料完整性的現代定義已從早期的 ALCOA 擴展為 ALCOA+：
blocks.en: The modern definition of data integrity has expanded from the early ALCOA to ALCOA+:

blocks.zh: Attributable（可歸屬性）— 可識別執行者
blocks.en: Attributable: the person who performed the action can be identified

blocks.zh: Legible（可辨識性）— 清楚可讀
blocks.en: Legible: clearly readable

blocks.zh: Contemporaneous（同步性）— 即時記錄
blocks.en: Contemporaneous: recorded at the time of the activity

blocks.zh: Original（原始性）— 第一手記錄
blocks.en: Original: the first-hand record

blocks.zh: Accurate（準確性）— 正確無誤
blocks.en: Accurate: correct and error-free

blocks.zh: + Complete（完整性）、Consistent（一致性）、Enduring（持久性）、Available（可用性）
blocks.en: + Complete, Consistent, Enduring, Available

blocks.zh: 監管重點：所有違規均須調查
blocks.en: Regulatory Focus: All Violations Must Be Investigated

blocks.zh: 這句話至關重要——不論是人員疏失還是蓄意造假，都必須啟動調查。許多公司誤以為「無意的錯誤」可以不調查，這本身就是 GMP 違規。
blocks.en: This statement is critical: whether the cause is human error or deliberate falsification, an investigation must be started. Many companies wrongly assume that an "unintentional mistake" does not need investigating, and that assumption is itself a GMP violation.

blocks.zh: 比喻：資料像工廠的「DNA」
blocks.en: Analogy: Data Is the Plant's "DNA"

blocks.zh: 想像一個無菌充填廠，每一批次的生產記錄就像是那批藥品的 DNA。若這個 DNA 有缺陷（資料不完整、被竄改），你就無法証明這批藥是安全的——不管藥品本身多好。
blocks.en: Picture a sterile filling plant: the production record of each batch is like the DNA of that batch of drug product. If that DNA is defective (incomplete or altered data), you cannot prove the batch is safe, no matter how good the product itself is.

blocks.zh: 資料完整性控制措施，就是保護這份「生產 DNA」從誕生到保存期滿，始終真實可信。
blocks.en: Data integrity controls protect this "production DNA" so that it stays true and trustworthy from the moment it is created until the end of its retention period.

blocks.zh: 風險導向 (Risk-based) 方法的必要性
blocks.en: Why a Risk-Based Approach Is Needed

blocks.zh: TR84 明確指出：「一刀切」的資料完整性控制在今日不可行。隨著：
blocks.en: TR84 states clearly that a "one-size-fits-all" approach to data integrity controls is no longer practical, given:

blocks.zh: 電子資料爆炸性成長
blocks.en: Explosive growth in electronic data

blocks.zh: 記憶體成本大幅降低
blocks.en: Sharply lower memory costs

blocks.zh: 混合系統 (Hybrid System) 普及
blocks.en: The widespread use of hybrid systems

blocks.zh: 必須以 QRM（品質風險管理）為基礎，依資料的「關鍵性」與「脆弱性」決定控制強度。
blocks.en: Control must be built on QRM (quality risk management), with the level of control set according to the criticality and vulnerability of the data.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務情境
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Scenario

blocks.zh: 您的廠區正在使用紙本批次記錄（BPR），同時部分設備已配備電子記錄系統（如環境監控 BMS）。這就是典型的「混合系統 (Hybrid System)」。TR84 的資料完整性控制原則同樣適用——不能因為「這部分是紙本」就降低要求。
blocks.en: Your site uses paper batch production records (BPR), while some equipment already has electronic recording systems (such as the environmental monitoring BMS). This is a typical "hybrid system". The data integrity control principles of TR84 apply equally; the requirements cannot be lowered just because "this part is on paper".

blocks.zh: Purpose / 目的
blocks.en: Purpose

blocks.zh: TR84 的三大目的
blocks.en: The Three Purposes of TR84

blocks.zh: 診斷問題：協助業界識別每個製造步驟的資料完整性風險
blocks.en: Diagnose problems: help industry identify the data integrity risks at each manufacturing step

blocks.zh: 提供工具：以 QRM（品質風險管理）框架評估各步驟所需的控制強度
blocks.en: Provide tools: use a QRM (quality risk management) framework to assess the level of control each step needs

blocks.zh: 建立最佳實踐：整合來自全球業界與監管機構的專家意見，提供最佳實務指引
blocks.en: Establish best practices: bring together expert input from industry and regulators worldwide to provide best-practice guidance

blocks.zh: 業界普遍的困惑點
blocks.en: A Common Source of Confusion in Industry

blocks.zh: TR84 坦承：「many companies continue to struggle」——許多公司知道資料要準確完整，但不清楚每個步驟需要多少控制。
blocks.en: TR84 admits that "many companies continue to struggle": they know data must be accurate and complete, but are unsure how much control each step needs.

blocks.zh: 這正是本報告的核心價值：提供一個系統化的 QRM 方法，讓決策有依據，而非靠感覺。
blocks.en: This is the core value of the report: it offers a systematic QRM approach so that decisions rest on evidence rather than on gut feeling.

blocks.zh: 比喻：QRM 就像保險精算
blocks.en: Analogy: QRM Is Like Insurance Actuarial Work

blocks.zh: QRM（品質風險管理）用於資料完整性，就像保險公司做精算：不是每個風險都要買最高保額，而是根據「發生機率 × 嚴重度 × 可偵測性」來決定保多少。
blocks.en: Applying QRM (quality risk management) to data integrity is like an insurer doing actuarial work: not every risk needs the highest coverage; the amount of cover is decided by "probability of occurrence × severity × detectability".

blocks.zh: 例如：無菌充填的關鍵製程參數記錄，風險高 → 需要電子稽核軌跡；倉儲搬運的非關鍵記錄，風險低 → 紙本雙人確認可能已足夠。
blocks.en: For example, the critical process parameter records of sterile filling are high risk, so they need an electronic audit trail; a non-critical warehouse handling record is low risk, so paper with two-person verification may be enough.

blocks.zh: 資料完整性是組織責任，不只是 QA 的事
blocks.en: Data Integrity Is an Organizational Responsibility, Not Just a QA Matter

blocks.zh: TR84 明確說明：所有人都有責任——
blocks.en: TR84 states clearly that everyone is responsible:

blocks.zh: 管理者（Managers）
blocks.en: Managers

blocks.zh: 品保人員（QA personnel）
blocks.en: QA personnel

blocks.zh: 操作員（Operators）
blocks.en: Operators

blocks.zh: 技術員（Technicians）
blocks.en: Technicians

blocks.zh: 支援人員（Support staff）
blocks.en: Support staff

blocks.zh: 這不是 QA 部門的獨立責任；資料完整性需要全廠文化的支持。
blocks.en: This is not the QA department's responsibility alone; data integrity needs the support of a site-wide culture.

blocks.zh: 思考問題
blocks.en: Questions to Consider

blocks.zh: 在您的 CDMO 廠區，目前是否有一份文件明確列出每個製造步驟的資料完整性控制要求（包含控制類型與審查頻率）？若無，TR84 的 QRM 方法可作為建立此文件的起點。
blocks.en: At your CDMO site, is there currently a document that clearly lists the data integrity control requirements for each manufacturing step (including the type of control and the review frequency)? If not, the QRM approach in TR84 can serve as the starting point for creating one.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用情境
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario

blocks.zh: 適用範圍涵蓋 APIs、固體口服劑型、無菌注射劑、生物製劑及疫苗。作為無菌充填 CDMO，TR84 的每一條原則都直接適用於您的日常作業——從充填機的製程參數記錄，到滅菌紀錄的電子稽核軌跡管理。
blocks.en: The scope covers APIs, oral solid dosage forms, sterile injectables, biologics and vaccines. For a sterile filling CDMO, every principle in TR84 applies directly to day-to-day operations, from the process parameter records of the filling machine to the management of electronic audit trails for sterilization records.

blocks.zh: Scope / 適用範圍
blocks.en: Scope

blocks.zh: TR84 適用範圍：製造與包裝作業
blocks.en: TR84 Scope: Manufacturing and Packaging Operations

blocks.zh: TR84 的涵蓋範圍包括：
blocks.en: The scope of TR84 includes:

blocks.zh: 製造作業（Manufacturing operations）
blocks.en: Manufacturing operations

blocks.zh: 物料管理（Materials）
blocks.en: Materials

blocks.zh: 廠房與設備（Facilities & equipment）
blocks.en: Facilities & equipment

blocks.zh: 生產記錄（Production）
blocks.en: Production

blocks.zh: 包裝與標示（Packaging & labeling）
blocks.en: Packaging & labeling

blocks.zh: 製程中控制（In-process controls）
blocks.en: In-process controls

blocks.zh: 製程分析檢測（Process analytical testing）
blocks.en: Process analytical testing

blocks.zh: 重要排除項：TR84 不涵蓋實驗室
blocks.en: Key Exclusion: TR84 Does Not Cover Laboratories

blocks.zh: TR84 不涵蓋：
blocks.en: TR84 does not cover:

blocks.zh: 實驗室/QC 的資料完整性 → 請參閱 PDA TR80
blocks.en: Laboratory/QC data integrity: see PDA TR80

blocks.zh: 臨床試驗的資料完整性管理
blocks.en: Data integrity management for clinical trials

blocks.zh: 品質管理系統（QMS）的資料完整性（規劃於未來報告）
blocks.en: Data integrity for the quality management system (QMS), planned for a future report

blocks.zh: 稽核時，若查驗員問起實驗室 OOS 記錄的資料完整性，應引用 TR80 而非 TR84。
blocks.en: During an inspection, if the inspector asks about data integrity of laboratory OOS records, cite TR80 rather than TR84.

blocks.zh: 比喻：TR84 是「生產線上的指南」
blocks.en: Analogy: TR84 Is the "Shop-Floor Guide"

blocks.zh: 把 PDA 的資料完整性系列想成一套工具箱——TR84 是專門給「生產線現場」使用的工具，TR80 是給「實驗室」的工具。兩套工具設計原理相同（ALCOA+），但應用場景不同，不能混用。
blocks.en: Think of the PDA data integrity series as a toolbox: TR84 is the tool made for the production floor, and TR80 is the tool for the laboratory. The two share the same design principles (ALCOA+) but apply to different settings and must not be mixed up.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務對照
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Cross-Reference

blocks.zh: 身為無菌充填 CDMO，TR84 直接適用於以下作業：
blocks.en: As a sterile filling CDMO, TR84 applies directly to the following operations:

blocks.zh: 充填機操作記錄（電子或紙本 BPR）
blocks.en: Filling machine operating records (electronic or paper BPR)

blocks.zh: 高壓蒸氣滅菌器的滅菌循環電子記錄
blocks.en: Electronic records of autoclave sterilization cycles

blocks.zh: 環境監控（BMS/DeltaV 系統）的資料管理
blocks.en: Data management for environmental monitoring (BMS/DeltaV systems)

blocks.zh: 包裝線的批號標示驗証記錄
blocks.en: Batch number labeling verification records on the packaging line

blocks.zh: 製程中重量/體積檢查的紀錄
blocks.en: Records of in-process weight/volume checks

blocks.zh: 而 QC 實驗室的 HPLC、微生物測試等記錄，則由 TR80 規範。
blocks.en: Records from the QC laboratory, such as HPLC and microbiological testing, are governed by TR80.

blocks.zh: Glossary and Abbreviations / 術語詞彙表與縮寫
blocks.en: Glossary and Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 稽核軌跡 (Audit Trail) — 監管核心
blocks.en: Audit Trail: A Regulatory Cornerstone

blocks.zh: 三大監管機構（FDA、MHRA、WHO）定義的核心一致：
blocks.en: The three regulators (FDA, MHRA, WHO) agree on the core of the definition:

blocks.zh: 安全、防竄改
blocks.en: Secure and tamper-resistant

blocks.zh: 時間戳記（time-stamped）
blocks.en: Time-stamped

blocks.zh: 記錄「誰、什麼、何時、為何」（who, what, when, why）
blocks.en: Records who, what, when and why

blocks.zh: 不得覆蓋原始記錄
blocks.en: Must not overwrite the original record

blocks.zh: MHRA 版本最完整，強調「who, what, when and why」四要素，是稽核員最常引用的標準。
blocks.en: The MHRA version is the most complete, stressing the four elements "who, what, when and why", and is the standard auditors cite most often.

blocks.zh: ATRA — 稽核軌跡審查評估
blocks.en: ATRA: Audit Trail Review Assessment

blocks.zh: ATRA（Audit Trail Review Assessment）是 TR84 引入的實用工具，解決了一個常見問題：「我需要審查稽核軌跡中的哪些內容？多久審查一次？」
blocks.en: ATRA (Audit Trail Review Assessment) is a practical tool introduced by TR84 that answers a common question: "What do I need to review in the audit trail, and how often?"

blocks.zh: 很多公司開啟了電子稽核軌跡，卻沒有定期、有系統地審查，這在 FDA/MHRA 稽查中是一個常見的觀察缺失。
blocks.en: Many companies switch on electronic audit trails but never review them regularly and systematically, which is a common observation in FDA/MHRA inspections.

blocks.zh: 比喻：Contemporaneous 就像監視錄影
blocks.en: Analogy: Contemporaneous Is Like Surveillance Video

blocks.zh: 「同步性」要求事發當下即時記錄，不能事後回憶補填。就像交通事故——監視器錄下的是真實情況，但事後憑記憶寫的陳述書，即使誠實，法律效力也低得多。
blocks.en: "Contemporaneous" requires recording at the moment the event happens, not filling in from memory afterwards. Think of a traffic accident: the camera records what really happened, whereas a statement written later from memory, however honest, carries far less legal weight.

blocks.zh: 在製藥製造中，補填批次記錄（back-dating entries）是最常見的資料完整性違規之一。
blocks.en: In pharmaceutical manufacturing, back-dating batch record entries is one of the most common data integrity violations.

blocks.zh: CP / CPP / CQA — 製藥製造三角關係
blocks.en: CP / CPP / CQA: The Triangle of Pharmaceutical Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 理解這三個概念的層次關係，對資料完整性的風險評估至關重要：
blocks.en: Understanding the hierarchy among these three concepts is essential for data integrity risk assessment:

blocks.zh:
CQA 關鍵品質屬性
（產品品質目標）
blocks.en:
CQA Critical Quality Attribute
(product quality target)

blocks.zh: ↑ 影響
blocks.en: ↑ Affects

blocks.zh:
CP 關鍵製程
（影響 CQA 的製程）
blocks.en:
CP Critical Process
(process that affects a CQA)

blocks.zh: ↑ 控制
blocks.en: ↑ Controls

blocks.zh:
CPP 關鍵製程參數
（需監控的參數）
blocks.en:
CPP Critical Process Parameter
(parameter to be monitored)

blocks.zh: CPP 的資料記錄，因為直接影響 CQA（產品品質），需要最嚴格的資料完整性控制。
blocks.en: Because CPP data records directly affect CQAs (product quality), they need the strictest data integrity controls.

blocks.zh: 資料完整性控制 (Data Integrity Controls) — 雙重目的
blocks.en: Data Integrity Controls: A Dual Purpose

blocks.zh: TR84 明確定義資料完整性控制有兩種目的：
blocks.en: TR84 defines two purposes for data integrity controls:

blocks.zh: 預防（Prevention）：最小化資料完整性問題發生的可能性
blocks.en: Prevention: minimize the likelihood that a data integrity problem occurs

blocks.zh: 偵測（Detection）：若問題發生，提高被發現的機率
blocks.en: Detection: if a problem does occur, increase the chance that it is found

blocks.zh: 這與 QRM 中的「風險控制」思維一致：優先預防，但也要有能力偵測。
blocks.en: This is consistent with the "risk control" thinking in QRM: prevention comes first, but the ability to detect must also be in place.

blocks.zh: 資料生命週期 (Data Lifecycle) — 從生到終
blocks.en: Data Lifecycle: From Start to Finish

blocks.zh: MHRA 定義（較簡潔）：從初始產生 → 記錄 → 處理 → 使用 → 保留 → 歸檔/取用 → 銷毀
blocks.en: MHRA definition (more concise): from initial generation → recording → processing → use → retention → archive/retrieval → destruction

blocks.zh: WHO 定義（較完整）：強調應有「計劃性的方法」來評估、監控並管理資料及其風險——要與病患安全、產品品質及決策可靠性的影響相稱。
blocks.en: WHO definition (more complete): emphasizes a "planned approach" to assess, monitor and manage the data and the risks to them, in a way commensurate with the impact on patient safety, product quality and the reliability of decisions.

blocks.zh: Looped Memory — 高風險陷阱
blocks.en: Looped Memory: A High-Risk Trap

blocks.zh: 「循環記憶體（Looped Memory）」是許多老舊設備（如老型充填機、天平）的內建儲存方式：儲滿了就自動覆蓋最舊的資料。
blocks.en: "Looped memory" is the built-in storage method of many older instruments (such as older filling machines and balances): once full, it automatically overwrites the oldest data.

blocks.zh: 這直接違反 ALCOA+ 的「Enduring（持久性）」要求。解決方案：
blocks.en: This directly violates the "Enduring" requirement of ALCOA+. Solutions:

blocks.zh: 定期下載並儲存到受控系統
blocks.en: Download the data regularly and store it in a controlled system

blocks.zh: 或升級為具備更大容量或即時傳輸能力的設備
blocks.en: Or upgrade to equipment with larger capacity or real-time data transfer

blocks.zh: True Copy（真實副本）— 必須保留內容與意義
blocks.en: True Copy: Must Preserve Content and Meaning

blocks.zh: 三大監管機構的共識：真實副本必須保留原始記錄的全部內容與意義。
blocks.en: The three regulators agree that a true copy must preserve the full content and meaning of the original record.

blocks.zh: 對電子記錄特別重要：
blocks.en: This is especially important for electronic records:

blocks.zh: 必須包含所有必要的 metadata
blocks.en: It must include all necessary metadata

blocks.zh: 必須保留靜態或動態格式（如 PDF 列印紙本不等同於原始電子檔）
blocks.en: It must preserve the static or dynamic format (for example, a PDF printout is not equivalent to the original electronic file)

blocks.zh: 電子副本需透過驗證流程產生，或有日期簽核
blocks.en: An electronic copy must be generated through a validated process, or be dated and signed off

blocks.zh: 比喻：Gemba Walk 就是「走動管理」
blocks.en: Analogy: Gemba Walk Is "Management by Walking Around"

blocks.zh: Gemba Walk 源自日文「現場」，是管理者親自到生產現場觀察的方法。在資料完整性管理中，Gemba Walk 是發現「書面 SOP 和實際操作差距」的最有效手段。
blocks.en: The Gemba Walk comes from the Japanese word for "the actual place" and is a method in which managers go to the production floor in person to observe. In data integrity management, the Gemba Walk is the most effective way to find the gap between the written SOP and actual practice.

blocks.zh: 很多資料完整性問題不是政策層面的問題，而是現場執行的習慣問題——只有走到現場才能看到。
blocks.en: Many data integrity problems are not policy-level problems but habits in day-to-day execution, and they can only be seen by going to the floor.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用情境 — Historian 系統
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario: Historian Systems

blocks.zh: Historian（歷史資料庫）在 CDMO 中通常是 DCS（如 DeltaV）或 SCADA 系統的一部分，自動記錄：
blocks.en: In a CDMO, the historian is usually part of a DCS (such as DeltaV) or SCADA system and automatically records:

blocks.zh: 充填機的填充重量趨勢
blocks.en: Fill weight trends of the filling machine

blocks.zh: 高壓蒸氣滅菌器的溫度/壓力曲線
blocks.en: Temperature/pressure curves of the autoclave

blocks.zh: 環境控制系統（BMS）的溫濕度數據
blocks.en: Temperature and humidity data from the environmental control system (BMS)

blocks.zh: Historian 系統本身也必須納入 CSV（電腦系統驗證）範疇，確保其記錄的資料完整性。
blocks.en: The historian system itself must also be included in CSV (computerized system validation) to ensure the integrity of the data it records.

blocks.zh: 在您廠區的製造系統中，哪些設備可能存在「Looped Memory（循環記憶體）」問題？這些資料目前是如何確保在覆蓋前被完整保存的？
blocks.en: Which equipment in your site's manufacturing systems may have a "looped memory" problem? How is that data currently kept complete before it is overwritten?

blocks.zh: 資料完整性 (Data Integrity) — 三大監管機構定義比較
blocks.en: Data Integrity: Comparison of the Three Regulators' Definitions

blocks.zh: MHRA 和 WHO 的定義比 FDA 更廣泛，強調「整個資料生命週期」和「品質風險管理系統」。全球 CDMO 應以最嚴格的要求為準。
blocks.en: The MHRA and WHO definitions are broader than the FDA's, emphasizing the "entire data lifecycle" and the "quality risk management system". A global CDMO should work to the most stringent requirement.

blocks.zh: Abbreviations / 縮寫對照表
blocks.en: Abbreviations

blocks.zh: CDMO 人員必懂縮寫
blocks.en: Abbreviations Every CDMO Employee Must Know

blocks.zh: 以下縮寫在 TR84 全文反覆出現，須熟記其含義：
blocks.en: The following abbreviations appear repeatedly throughout TR84 and their meanings must be memorized:

blocks.zh: ALCOA：資料完整性核心原則縮寫，加 + 號為 ALCOA+
blocks.en: ALCOA: the acronym for the core data integrity principles; with a + sign it becomes ALCOA+

blocks.zh: BPR（批次生產記錄）：製造作業的核心文件
blocks.en: BPR (batch production record): the core document of manufacturing operations

blocks.zh: EBR（電子批次記錄）：BPR 的電子化版本
blocks.en: EBR (electronic batch record): the electronic version of the BPR

blocks.zh: BMS（建築管理系統）：廠房溫濕度、壓差等環境監控系統
blocks.en: BMS (building management system): the system that monitors the facility environment, such as temperature, humidity and differential pressure

blocks.zh: MES（製造執行系統）：整合生產排程、批次記錄的中介系統
blocks.en: MES (manufacturing execution system): the middle-layer system that integrates production scheduling and batch records

blocks.zh: HMI（人機介面）：設備操作介面，常見於充填機、滅菌器
blocks.en: HMI (human-machine interface): the equipment operating interface, common on filling machines and sterilizers

blocks.zh: PLC（可程式化邏輯控制器）：設備自動化控制核心，其記錄需 CSV
blocks.en: PLC (programmable logic controller): the core of equipment automation control, whose records require CSV

blocks.zh: QRM（品質風險管理）：TR84 的核心評估方法論
blocks.en: QRM (quality risk management): the core assessment methodology of TR84

blocks.zh: 監管機構縮寫 — 全球視野
blocks.en: Regulatory Abbreviations: A Global View

blocks.zh: TR84 是國際性文件，引用的監管機構包括：
blocks.en: TR84 is an international document, and the regulators it cites include:

blocks.zh: FDA（美國）— 21 CFR Part 11、211 等
blocks.en: FDA (United States): 21 CFR Part 11, Part 211, etc.

blocks.zh: MHRA（英國）— Data Integrity Guidance 業界公認最詳細
blocks.en: MHRA (United Kingdom): its Data Integrity Guidance is widely regarded as the most detailed

blocks.zh: WHO（世界衛生組織）— 適用於開發中國家市場
blocks.en: WHO (World Health Organization): applicable to markets in developing countries

blocks.zh: TGA（澳洲）
blocks.en: TGA (Australia)

blocks.zh: NMPA（中國）— 大陸市場合規需額外注意
blocks.en: NMPA (China): additional attention is needed for compliance in the mainland China market

blocks.zh: PIC/S — 歐洲藥廠互查協定，歐盟 GMP 框架基礎
blocks.en: PIC/S: the Pharmaceutical Inspection Co-operation Scheme, the basis of the European GMP framework

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，您的客戶可能來自不同市場，需同時符合多個監管機構要求。
blocks.en: As a CDMO, your clients may come from different markets, so you need to meet the requirements of several regulators at the same time.

blocks.zh: 比喻：MES vs EBR vs BMS
blocks.en: Analogy: MES vs EBR vs BMS

blocks.zh: 這三個系統的層級關係：
blocks.en: The hierarchy among these three systems:

blocks.zh: BMS：記錄廠房環境（溫濕度、壓差）— 就像「氣象站」
blocks.en: BMS: records the facility environment (temperature, humidity, differential pressure), like a "weather station"

blocks.zh: EBR：記錄批次生產過程（投料、操作、檢查）— 就像「航行日誌」
blocks.en: EBR: records the batch production process (charging, operations, checks), like a "ship's log"

blocks.zh: MES：整合兩者並管理生產排程 — 就像「指揮艦橋」
blocks.en: MES: integrates the two and manages production scheduling, like the "command bridge"

blocks.zh: 三者的資料完整性控制要求各有不同，都需納入 CSV 驗證範疇。
blocks.en: The data integrity control requirements differ for each of the three, and all fall within the scope of CSV.

blocks.zh: CDMO 盤點建議
blocks.en: CDMO Inventory Recommendation

blocks.zh: 建議您的 IT/QA 團隊建立一份「系統清單」，列出廠區中每個涉及資料記錄的系統（HMI、BMS、Historian、EBR、LIMS 等），並標示：
blocks.en: We recommend that your IT/QA team create a "system inventory" listing every system on site that records data (HMI, BMS, historian, EBR, LIMS, etc.) and noting:

blocks.zh: 是否已完成 CSV 驗證
blocks.en: Whether CSV has been completed

blocks.zh: Audit Trail 是否已啟用並定期審查
blocks.en: Whether the audit trail is enabled and reviewed regularly

blocks.zh: 資料保存期限與備份機制
blocks.en: Data retention period and backup mechanism

blocks.zh: 這份清單是建立資料完整性程序的起點，也是稽查時的關鍵文件。
blocks.en: This list is the starting point for building data integrity procedures and is also a key document during inspections.

blocks.zh: Section Summary / 本節總結
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 關鍵概念整合回顧
blocks.en: Key Concepts Recap

blocks.zh: 本節核心要點總整理
blocks.en: Key Takeaways of This Section

blocks.zh:
1. 資料完整性是 GMP 的基石
TR84 第一句話就點明：資料完整性（Data Integrity）是確立並維持對產品品質與病患安全信心的基石。所有資料完整性違規，無論有意或無意，都必須調查。
blocks.en:
1. Data integrity is the cornerstone of GMP
The very first statement of TR84 makes the point that data integrity is the foundation for establishing and maintaining confidence in product quality and patient safety. All data integrity violations, intentional or not, must be investigated.

blocks.zh:
2. ALCOA+ 是九項原則，不只五項
ALCOA（可歸屬性、可辨識性、同步性、原始性、準確性）是基礎，加上 Complete（完整性）、Consistent（一致性）、Enduring（持久性）、Available（可用性）構成 ALCOA+。每一項都有其特定的控制要求。
blocks.en:
2. ALCOA+ has nine principles, not just five
ALCOA (attributable, legible, contemporaneous, original, accurate) is the basis; adding complete, consistent, enduring and available makes ALCOA+. Each one has its own specific control requirements.

blocks.zh:
3. TR84 的範疇是製造與包裝，不包含實驗室
實驗室的資料完整性管理由 PDA TR80 規範。兩份文件合讀，才能覆蓋整個藥廠的資料完整性管理需求。
blocks.en:
3. TR84 covers manufacturing and packaging, not laboratories
Data integrity management in the laboratory is governed by PDA TR80. The two documents must be read together to cover the data integrity needs of the whole pharmaceutical plant.

blocks.zh:
4. 混合系統（Hybrid System）是常態，需特別管理
大多數藥廠仍在紙本與電子系統的過渡期，混合系統的資料完整性控制是 TR84 的重點之一。過渡期間不能以「我們還沒全電子化」為藉口降低要求。
blocks.en:
4. Hybrid systems are the norm and need special management
Most pharmaceutical plants are still in transition between paper and electronic systems, and data integrity control of hybrid systems is one of the focal points of TR84. During the transition, "we are not fully electronic yet" cannot be used as an excuse to lower requirements.

blocks.zh:
5. QRM（品質風險管理）是評估框架
資料完整性控制的強度應與資料的「關鍵性」和「脆弱性」相稱。QRM 是 TR84 全文的核心評估方法，避免「一刀切」的過度或不足控制。
blocks.en:
5. QRM (quality risk management) is the assessment framework
The strength of data integrity controls should be commensurate with the criticality and vulnerability of the data. QRM is the core assessment method throughout TR84 and avoids "one-size-fits-all" over-control or under-control.

blocks.zh: 稽查高頻問題預警
blocks.en: Early Warning: Frequent Inspection Questions

blocks.zh: FDA/MHRA 稽查員在製造作業中最常問的資料完整性問題：
blocks.en: The data integrity questions FDA/MHRA inspectors ask most often in manufacturing operations:

blocks.zh: 您的稽核軌跡（Audit Trail）是否已啟用？審查頻率是多少？（ATRA 評估是否存在）
blocks.en: Is your audit trail enabled? How often is it reviewed? (Is there an ATRA assessment?)

blocks.zh: 操作員的電腦登入帳號是否共用？（Attributable 要求）
blocks.en: Do operators share computer login accounts? (Attributable requirement)

blocks.zh: 是否有設備因 Looped Memory 導致資料被覆蓋的風險？
blocks.en: Is there equipment at risk of data being overwritten because of looped memory?

blocks.zh: 紙本批次記錄的修改是否符合「單線劃除、簽名、日期、原因」原則？
blocks.en: Are corrections to paper batch records made according to the principle of single-line strike-through, signature, date and reason?

blocks.zh: 電子記錄的備份機制是否驗證過？True Copy 是否符合監管定義？
blocks.en: Has the backup mechanism for electronic records been validated? Do true copies meet the regulatory definition?

blocks.zh: 本節學後行動 — CDMO 實踐建議
blocks.en: Post-Study Actions for This Section: CDMO Practice Recommendations

blocks.zh: 做系統盤點：列出廠區所有產生 GMP 記錄的系統（電子 + 紙本），確認每個系統的資料完整性控制狀態。
blocks.en: Carry out a system inventory: list all systems on site that generate GMP records (electronic and paper) and confirm the data integrity control status of each.

blocks.zh: 驗證 Audit Trail 啟用狀態：確認所有電子系統的稽核軌跡已啟用，並建立 ATRA（稽核軌跡審查評估）程序。
blocks.en: Verify audit trail status: confirm that audit trails are enabled on all electronic systems, and establish an ATRA (audit trail review assessment) procedure.

blocks.zh: 識別 Looped Memory 設備：找出廠區中使用循環記憶體的老舊設備，建立資料定期備份程序。
blocks.en: Identify looped memory equipment: find older equipment on site that uses looped memory and set up a regular data backup procedure.

blocks.zh: 宣導「資料完整性是全員責任」：確保操作員到管理階層都理解 ALCOA+ 要求，特別是「Contemporaneous（同步性）」——不得事後補填記錄。
blocks.en: Promote "data integrity is everyone's responsibility": make sure everyone from operators to senior management understands the ALCOA+ requirements, especially "Contemporaneous": records must not be filled in after the fact.

blocks.zh: 最後比喻：資料完整性就像建築的地基
blocks.en: Final Analogy: Data Integrity Is Like a Building's Foundation

blocks.zh: 無論你的製程技術多先進、設備多新穎，若資料完整性這塊「地基」不穩，整棟 GMP 大樓就可能倒塌。FDA Warning Letter 和進口禁令，許多不是因為產品本身有問題，而是因為記錄無法被信任——監管機構無法確認那批藥是否真的按照 GMP 製造。
blocks.en: No matter how advanced your process technology or how new your equipment, if the "foundation" of data integrity is unstable, the whole GMP building may collapse. Many FDA Warning Letters and import bans were issued not because the product itself had a problem, but because the records could not be trusted: the regulator could not confirm that the batch was really made in accordance with GMP.

blocks.zh: TR84 的核心訊息：資料的可信度，決定了產品的可信度。
blocks.en: The core message of TR84: the credibility of the data determines the credibility of the product.
